title: Axiom Gas Engineering IPO Details
intro:
Axiom Gas Engineering IPO is a book build issue of ₹49.81 crores. The issue is entirely a fresh issue of 93.98 lakh shares of ₹49.81 crore.

Axiom Gas Engineering IPO opens for subscription on Sep 18, 2026 and closes on Sep 22, 2026. The allotment for the Axiom Gas Engineering IPO is expected to be finalized on Sep 23, 2026. Axiom Gas Engineering IPO will list on the NSE SME with a tentative listing date fixed as Sep 25, 2026.

Axiom Gas Engineering IPO is set issue price band at ₹50 to ₹53 per share. The lot size for an application is 2,000 shares. The minimum amount of investment required by an individual investor (retail) is ₹2,12,000 (4,000 shares) (based on upper price). The minimum lot size for investment in HNI is 3 lots (6,000 shares), amounting to ₹3,18,000.

SKI Capital Services Ltd. is the book running lead manager and Kfin Technologies Ltd. is the registrar of the issue. The Market Maker of the company is Sunflower Broking Pvt.Ltd.

Refer to Axiom Gas Engineering IPO RHP for detailed Information.

Statutory Testing and Certification : Testing and Certification for hydrocarbon equipment, ensuring compliance with safety standards. Technical Consultancy : Provide expert guidance on hydrocarbon equipment design and optimization. Maintenance Operation and Training : Provides maintenance and training programs to enhance gas system longevity and performance. Manufacturing Pressure Vessels Through Third-Party Collaboration. Specializing in Industrial and Commercial LPG solutions. Competitive Strength: Expertise in Executing Projects in Challenging Geographical Locations. faqs.question: How to apply in Axiom Gas Engineering IPO through Zerodha?
faqs.answer: Zerodha customers can apply online in Axiom Gas Engineering IPO using UPI as a payment gateway. Zerodha customers can apply in Axiom Gas Engineering IPO by login into Zerodha Console (back office) and submitting an IPO application form. Steps to apply in Axiom Gas Engineering IPO through Zerodha Visit the Zerodha website and login to Console. Go to Portfolio and click the IPOs link. Go to the ' Axiom Gas Engineering IPO ' row and click the 'Bid' button. Enter your UPI ID, Quantity, and Price. Submit IPO application form. Visit the UPI App (net banking or BHIM ) to approve the mandate. Visit Zerodha IPO Application Process Review for more detail.

faqs.question: How to apply for Axiom Gas Engineering IPO?
faqs.answer: You can apply in Axiom Gas Engineering IPO online using either UPI or ASBA as a payment method. ASBA IPO application is available in the net banking of your bank account. UPI IPO Application is offered by brokers who don't offer banking services. Read more detail about applying IPO online through Zerodha , Upstox , 5Paisa , Nuvama , HDFC Bank , and SBI Bank .
